summary: The comment offers a mix of clarifications, cautions, and policy suggestions regarding the E‑Rate program, focusing on carrier restrictions, CIPA TPM definitions, budget caps, data privacy, and consultant fee structures. The comment advocates several procedural changes to the E‑Rate program, including automatic application of online Form 479 to all consortia, streamlined state‑master‑contract pricing affirmation, clearer MIBS eligibility, and broader program adjustments to improve access and reduce costs.
